source_preview:
Designation – HR Manager/HR assistant manager
Experience – 4 to 6 years
Location – Vikhroli, Mumbai(On-site)
Notice Period – Immediate/45 days

Key Responsibilities
1. Recruitment & Onboarding

•
Manage end-to-end recruitment: sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, and
offer rollout.

•
Conduct new employee orientation and ensure smooth onboarding.
2. HR Operations

•
Maintain and update employee records, HRMS data, and documentation.

•
Handle employee queries related to HR policies, attendance, and payroll
coordination.

•
Support monthly payroll inputs: attendance, leaves, variable components, etc.
3. Employee Engagement

•
Plan and execute engagement activities, employee welfare programs, and R&R
initiatives.

•
Conduct regular employee connect sessions and feedback surveys.
4. Performance Management

•
Assist in goal-setting, mid-year, and annual appraisal processes.

•
Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure timely evaluations and documentation.
5. Policy & Compliance

•
Ensure adherence to company policies and statutory compliances (PF, ESI, gratuity,
labor laws).

•
Support audits and documentation as required.
6. Exit Management

•
Manage the full exit process: resignation acceptance, exit interviews, clearance, and
F&F coordination.

•
Analyze attrition trends and share insights.

Key Skills & Competencies

•
Strong knowledge of HR processes, labor laws, and best practices.

•
Excellent communication & interpersonal skills.

•
Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMS tools, and reporting.

•
Problem-solving, stakeholder management, and confidentiality handling.


Education

•
Bachelors degree in HR / Business Administration
